name: After § 18
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Ukraine
part_text: 18a. Notes with deep concern that, despite sustained EU support and the creation of formal anti-corruption institutions, corruption remains widespread in Ukraine, with limited political will to dismantle entrenched networks of oligarchic influence; stresses that public perception and independent assessments, including the Corruption Perceptions Index and reports by the European Court of Auditors, confirm that progress has stalled and key institutions lack true independence and enforcement power;
